reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Produces a platform-specific text-post draft by selecting a stated engagement objective, applying a structured hook, incorporating supplied evidence, and running a style and plausibility pass.
neutralIntentExamples: draft a professional post from this topic and my notes
reshape this draft around a question that invites substantive discussion
operations: report selected structure and character count
failureBehavior: ask for missing authentic details
treat performance figures as non-guaranteeing priors
avoid inventing anecdotes or metrics
flag incompatible or unverified claims
usefulInvariants: the opening must communicate the premise early
user facts and numbers remain distinguishable from generated framing
the selected objective must match the closing interaction pattern
format comparisons use like-for-like evidence
materialRisks: stale platform heuristics may be presented as current
engagement optimization can encourage manipulative or fabricated specificity
personal anecdotes may contain sensitive information
external links and claims need user verification

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Describes a command-line integration for retrieving professional and company data, searching entities, and performing account actions through a remote service with structured results and error codes.
neutralIntentExamples: find people matching these role and location filters
retrieve a company profile with a bounded set of recent posts
failureBehavior: surface authentication and account errors
surface rate limits and network failures
distinguish API success from action success
bound optional data retrieval
retain recovery identifiers for timeouts
exclusions: assuming a successful transport means a successful action
storing credentials in prompts or source files
usefulInvariants: read scope should be explicit and minimal
write actions require deliberate confirmation and auditability
machine output must expose action-level success
credentials must remain outside generated content
materialRisks: remote browser automation may violate platform terms
messages, reactions, and posts are consequential external writes
professional data can be personal or sensitive
rate limits and API behavior can change
credential handling is high impact

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Diagnoses and specifies page metadata and image-access conditions needed for social link previews, including platform variants, absolute URLs, and verification checks.
neutralIntentExamples: make this page render a correct preview when shared
audit the metadata and preview image for a dynamic article route
operations: map page data to preview metadata
failureBehavior: identify missing or malformed fields
flag inaccessible or incorrectly sized images
separate static and dynamic page remedies
request a reachable canonical origin when absent
usefulInvariants: canonical URLs are absolute and environment-appropriate
metadata describes the actual page
preview assets are reachable without accidental private access
changes are verified against rendered output
materialRisks: preview images can disclose private or unlicensed material
platform caches make verification time-dependent
provider field requirements drift
site configuration changes can affect production pages

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Organizes monitoring of public developer conversations into keyword categories, platform searches, sentiment and relevance scoring, and prioritized response opportunities.
neutralIntentExamples: summarize public discussions mentioning these product problems
rank recent developer conversations where a helpful response may be appropriate
failureBehavior: mark incomplete platform coverage
separate inferred sentiment from quoted evidence
avoid treating search absence as absence of discussion
defer engagement where identity or context is unclear
exclusions: equating negative sentiment with bad faith
usefulInvariants: source links and timestamps remain attached to findings
public availability does not erase privacy concerns
recommendations remain optional and human-reviewed
priority criteria are explicit
materialRisks: monitoring can become invasive profiling
sentiment classification is error-prone
public posts may contain personal or confidential information
cross-platform collection may violate terms
stale results can misdirect engagement

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Collects publicly available competitor advertising examples and structures their messages, audiences, problems, calls to action, and creative patterns for comparative analysis.
neutralIntentExamples: compare the public ad messages used by these competitors
extract recurring customer problems and calls to action from this ad set
failureBehavior: mark unavailable or incomplete ad records
preserve source attribution and capture time
distinguish observation from strategic inference
avoid filling missing creative details by guesswork
exclusions: automatically writing to a knowledge system without approval
usefulInvariants: each finding is traceable to a retrieved record
competitive observations are separated from recommendations
collection scope and date are explicit
persistence destinations are authorized
materialRisks: ad-library access and schemas change
stored research may contain copyrighted or personal material
creative imitation can create legal and ethical exposure
automated persistence can leak sensitive strategy
inferences may overstate performance

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Creates a compact visual quote or data card intended to accompany a short social post, with minimal guidance beyond the asset concept.
neutralIntentExamples: turn this verified statistic into a shareable square card
design a concise quote graphic for this short post
failureBehavior: request source and attribution for unverified claims
flag unreadable or overloaded text
defer when the visual brief is underspecified
usefulInvariants: text remains faithful to the supplied source
attribution is retained
the card remains legible at its intended display size
visual output has meaningful alternative text where applicable
materialRisks: misattributed quotes and decontextualized statistics spread quickly
image assets may raise licensing issues
platform dimensions and rendering behavior drift
minimal source guidance leaves important accessibility gaps

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Transforms user-provided career records into structured application documents with market and role targeting, parser-friendly formatting, consistency checks, and explicit missing-data reporting.
neutralIntentExamples: turn these career records into a fact-checked application document
adapt my supplied experience to this job description without adding unsupported claims
operations: map verified qualifications to role terms
run tense, blocklist, parser, and anti-hallucination checks
failureBehavior: mark unverifiable facts as missing
block output when truthfulness checks fail
preserve supplied dates and names
warn when OCR may be inaccurate
avoid adding absent skills or metrics
exclusions: treating ATS heuristics as universal law
usefulInvariants: every factual claim traces to supplied evidence
tense is consistent within each role
format remains parseable and single-column where required
missing data stays visibly missing
targeting never upgrades the user's qualifications
materialRisks: CVs contain highly sensitive personal and employment data
OCR and source merging can introduce false facts
ATS guidance varies by market and vendor
keyword targeting can incentivize misleading claims
document output may be reused beyond its intended audience
